description: Defines the AvailableEntityKeysV2 record, which contains information about entity types, time series keys, and attribute keys discovered from entities matching a query, including optional sample values.

classes.name: AvailableEntityKeysV2
classes.description: A record encapsulating entity types, time series keys, and attribute keys with optional sample values.

classes.name: AvailableEntityKeysV2.KeyInfo
classes.description: A record representing a key name with an optional sample value.

classes.name: AvailableEntityKeysV2.KeySample
classes.description: A record representing the most recent value and timestamp for a key.
